title: An Explicit 82-Queen Covering of the 163 x 163 Board and Its Asymptotic Implication
summary: The queen's graph $Q_n$ has the squares of the $n\times n$ chessboard as vertices, with adjacency defined by a common row, column, or diagonal. We give an explicit set of $82$ queens on $Q_{163}$. In centered coordinates, all queen coordinates are odd, every odd row and odd column is occupied exactly once, and the occupied rows, columns, and diagonals satisfy the conditions for a type A $1$-cover in the terminology of Ostergard and Weakley.
